# Repository metadata

Keep these in sync with the README; they are what people search.

**Description** (GitHub "About", ≤ 350 chars)

> An investment-research agent that has to prove its numbers. Plan as a typed
> IR, contracts as gatekeepers, point-in-time by construction. Open-source
> implementation of the "Pat / Pocket Analyst" architecture Bridgewater
> described at INTERRUPT26 — unaffiliated.

**Topics**

```
llm-agents  ai-agent  investment-research  research-agent  ai-analyst
point-in-time  look-ahead-bias  survivorship-bias  quantitative-finance
financial-data  data-contracts  dataframe-validation  pandas  duckdb
agentic-coding  compiler  reproducibility  evals  python
```

**Website**: the interactive architecture walkthrough (see README).

**Applying them**

```bash
gh repo edit leoncuhk/quantifact \
  --description "An investment-research agent that has to prove its numbers..." \
  --add-topic llm-agents --add-topic investment-research --add-topic point-in-time
```

**Social preview**: a screenshot of the point-in-time example output — the six
defences with two knowledge dates giving two different answers — reads better
than a logo, because it shows the one thing nothing else in this space does.
